faq.q: How much does a marketing agency cost per month in the UK?
faq.a: Usually £500–£2,000 a month for a small business and £2,000–£5,000 from a mid-size agency, plus VAT.

faq.q: What is a typical marketing retainer in the UK?
faq.a: Around £1,000–£3,000 a month for one or two channels with reporting.

faq.q: Do UK agencies charge set-up fees?
faq.a: Many do, typically £250–£1,500. Ask before you sign.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to get a marketing team?
